description.value: Tin Wis Resort is an 85-room beachfront hotel perched on the secluded tinwis (MacKenzie) Beach in Tofino, owned and operated by the Tla-o-qui-aht First Nation and situated within their traditional territories. It holds the distinction of housing the largest conference centre on the Pacific Rim and offers direct oceanfront access, making it one of the most culturally rooted lodging options in the region. Touring cyclists arriving via the Pacific Rim Highway find themselves steps from the ocean with surf and paddle equipment available and an on-site restaurant for refuelling.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website (tinwis.ca) is fully accessible and provides the primary evidence. It confirms the resort is an operational 85-room beachfront hotel owned by the Tla-o-qui-aht First Nation, with complimentary breakfast and an on-site restaurant (Browns Social House). No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, Wi-Fi, or other cycle-specific amenities appears anywhere in the fetched content, so those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; local phone 1-250-725-4445 and toll-free 1-800-661-9995 sourced from website only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
OSM address street uses 'Pacific Rim Hwy - Tin Wis Road'; website consistently uses 'Pacific Rim Highway' — minor formatting difference, not a substantive discrepancy.
The 'All Amenities' and 'Resort Map' subpages referenced on the website were not fetched; cycle-specific amenities (bike storage, laundry, Wi-Fi, etc.) may be listed there but could not be confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operational beachfront resort hotel with an active website, named staff, booking system, and clear physical address in Tofino. No indicators of closure.
enrichment_extras.notes: Resort is operated in partnership with Tla-o-qui-aht Tribal Parks and encourages guests to take the ʔiisaak (respect) pledge. The 'Surf, Paddle and Fitness Equipment' listed as a feature may be available for guest use but no bicycle equipment is specified.
